deadline.value: Fall entry only: January 15 for international applicants (February 1 for Canadian residents); year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: February 1 (Canadian resident) | January 15 (U.S. and international) | Priority will be given to complete applications submitted by the deadline.

supervisor.value: Name a supervisor on your application and contact faculty; no approval letter is needed, and the graduate studies committee makes the supervisor match.
supervisor.quote: You are required to identify a supervisor on your application. | A supervisor approval letter is not required. The graduate studies committee will match you with a supervisor.

funding.value: Funding packages (awards, TA and RA positions) are offered at admission to most thesis-based PhD students; no guaranteed amount is stated.
funding.quote: Funding packages are generally available for students in thesis-based programs. | teaching and research assistantships are offered at the time of admission to most students to allow them to focus on their research and studies.

entry_route.value: An MSc with high standing in mathematics, statistics or an allied field is required.
entry_route.quote: MSc degree, with high standing in Mathematics, Statistics, or an allied discipline from a recognized university.
